why: Lets a control measured without a pressable width pass instead of failing, which is how the reading would silently revert: with the guard gone the floor reads `undefined < 44` as false and every clipped control passes. A collector that stopped reporting the field would then look exactly like a clean sweep -- the same shape as `overflow.page`, which spent its whole life unable to fire.
killedBy: menu hit-target verdict (issue #686) fails a control measured without a pressable width, instead of falling back to its box
